source_evidence: You can find a firm’s or individual’s disciplinary history using our “Check Out Your Investment Professional” search tool at Investor.gov.
answer: A relationship summary (Form CRS) can tell you whether a firm or its financial professionals have reportable legal or disciplinary history. To research further, use Investor.gov’s “Check Out Your Investment Professional” search tool and select “firm” or “individual.” The source says that “Disclosure Reported” means the firm or individual has disciplinary history. For an individual, open “Get Full Report” and look under “Disclosures.” For a firm, open “Get Details”; brokerage-firm disclosures appear under “Disclosures,” while advisory-firm information is in “Part 2 Brochures” under “Disciplinary Information.” For a dual registrant, check both. The tool can also help you check whether a firm or individual is licensed.
